Hi Ana. Before you arrive, two things: you have to leave the keys in the metal box downstairs when you go.
Got it. Do I have to take the rubbish out every day?
No, you don't have to. But you should do it on Tuesday nights, otherwise it stays there until the next week.
Fine. And can I have two friends over on the Saturday?
You can, of course. But I have to warn you: you must not have parties. The neighbours are very strict about noise.
Two friends and a bottle of wine is not a party. Should I clean before I leave?
Don't bother, we do that. And if something breaks, you should message me instead of fixing it yourself.
Deal. I promise I won't break anything on purpose.
Do I have to book in advance?
You don't have to, but I'd recommend it.
I should warn you about one thing.
That one is not negotiable, unfortunately.
Could you send it by Thursday?

Hey, about Sunday. I want to warn you about a couple of things before you say yes. We have to leave at six in the morning, which is brutal, and the bus does not wait, so we really must be there on time. You do not have to bring food, because there is a place at the top, but honestly you should bring your own water. It is expensive up there and the queue is strict, one bottle per person. Oh, and you must not wear new shoes. My cousin did that last year on purpose because they looked good in photos and she could not walk for three days. Tell me tonight, because I have to confirm the seats.

Ana, quick one before the call. I have just read the new guidelines and there are two things you should know. First, we must not change the logo colour, not even a little. That one is not negotiable and the main stakeholder checks it personally. Second, we do not have to use their font in social posts, which everybody assumes we do, so that is good news for the campaign. My advice is that we should send them the layouts on Thursday instead of Friday. If they see it early, they can ask for small changes instead of big ones. You do not have to decide now, but let me know before the call.
